items.mainDefect: Wire cannot resolve the new int64 argument required by ProvideAnonDBStore, causing code generation to fail.

secondary.defect: Wire also rejects the unused store provider because ProvideAnonymousDeviceService now constructs the store itself.

items.mainDefect: Anonymous clients can bypass the device limit by omitting the X-Grafana-Device-Id header.

secondary.defect: An unauthenticated attacker can exhaust the shared device limit with random device IDs and deny access to legitimate new viewers.

items.mainDefect: Synchronous device registration puts repeated database round trips and an increasingly expensive COUNT query on the authentication hot path.

secondary.defect: The database work no longer has the previous bounded timeout.

items.mainDefect: The updateDevice comment implies a supplied time range even though the function derives a fixed window from device.UpdatedAt.

secondary.defect: The comment omits that updateDevice returns ErrDeviceLimitReached when no matching device exists.
